faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Saratoga?
faq.answer: Saratoga homeowners typically invest $14,000 to $40,000+ for window replacement projects. This exclusive Silicon Valley community features large estate homes and Eichler mid-century moderns where custom sizing and premium specifications are the norm. Projects covering 15–30+ windows with Marvin or Western Window Systems are typical.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Saratoga?
faq.answer: Yes. Saratoga requires a building permit for window replacements. Homes in the Historic Village area or those designated as heritage properties may require Heritage Preservation Committee review. Our team manages all permit applications and heritage review submittals on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Saratoga?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Saratoga commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Saratoga?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Saratoga replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Saratoga?
faq.answer: Most Saratoga projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
